title: Bullet Fire Fails to Break the Singhs

blocks.text: Close fighting does not subdue the two Singhs. They wrench out arrows, strike at horses with their sticks, and force their opponents to abandon the easy confidence of mounted combat.

Only after those efforts fail do the Mughals resort to muskets and opened a heavy shower of bullets. Even then the page emphasizes not the success of the volleys but the astonishing persistence of the wounded Singhs, who continue pressing forward after terrible injury.
The narrative lingers on endurance as spectacle. A body broken by gunfire still refuses inward defeat, which is precisely why the episode magnifies martyrdom into public instruction.
